title: result.verified (v1)
description: EvaluatorAgent has finished verifying the new_best result and frozen a VerificationReport into the Research Store (see agents/evaluator_agent/data-contracts/verification_report.schema.yaml). Payload is intentionally minimal: the result is read from the Research Store by ref. EvaluatorAgent's VerifyingBestResult mode is M12 -- this is the frozen contract only; no consumer wired yet.

verdict.description: EvaluatorAgent's verdict on whether the new_best result was verified.

verification_report_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen VerificationReport object.
